aarti.tek: Victory, victory to you, Śrī Śani Deva, benefactor of devotees. Lord, you are the son of Sūrya, and Chāyā is your mother.
aarti.pad1: Your body is dark, your gaze oblique, and you have four arms. Lord, you wear blue garments, and the elephant is your mount. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: A diadem crown shines on your head and your forehead glows; a garland of pearls graces your neck. I give myself to you. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Modakas, sweets, betel leaves and areca nuts are offered to you; iron, sesame, oil, black gram and the she-buffalo are very dear to you. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Gods, demons, seers, sages, men and women remember you; Viśvanātha meditates on you and is in your refuge. ॥4॥
